decision_rule: Census must match independent archived Sage. Compare complete target-dependent loop including every family, rejected family and final source-product check. Report all three arm timings and do not infer end-to-end speedup.
resource_envelope: one local native process at a time; 30 s subprocess timeout per arm; ordinary macOS arm64 host with no isolation tier
workload: 160 frozen public residual charts by 1554 source-admissible two-code families, eight roots each, 40 third-source products
